opening.argument: The description makes the recruitment pitch explicit: it advertises payment per referral, promises “Unlimited” and “100%” earning, and seeks 20 networkers. The visible materials reinforce that this is a paid-entry commission structure, presenting a “COMMISSION PAYOUT SYSTEM” and partner income alongside a stated 0.5 ETH joining payment, as well as a TRON smart contract with an 800 TRX joining payment. Taken together, these are recruitment-dependent earning claims paired with instructions to pay to join, not merely neutral blockchain education. The evidence establishes an active solicitation built around commissions and tiered participation; it does not establish actual losses or outcomes.
